targets.rationale: The day-level target is satisfied: evt_46 is a new athlete meeting on the expressly requested August 22, with the correct originating email and no duplicate in either full store. The key instead resolves dom:22,0m to June 22, contradicting the named month, so the reported wrong-day failure is unjustified. The NO for full model compliance is limited to a separate time/default defect: the assistant scheduled 10:00–12:00 although its instructions require 09:00 and one hour when unspecified. That defect does not justify rejecting the correct calendar day. The primary attribution is KEY; MODEL records the independent time/default error.
